caption: Right after sign up a 14 day Professional trial started without a card. The sidebar counts 0 of 1,000 plan tasks and says the trial ends on 2 December.
After five successful runs of our Forms to Tables test Zap, Task usage still finds no results and Plan tasks stays at 0 / 1.000. Those runs used no tasks.
With annual billing in euros, Professional costs EUR 18.62 a month for 750 tasks and Team EUR 64.26 a month for 2,000 tasks and 25 users. Free stays at 100 tasks a month.
Monthly billing raises Professional to EUR 27.93 and Team to EUR 96.40. The summary says annual billing saves EUR 111.76 a year on Professional. We did not check out.
Settings lets you download your data, delete only your Zap data and keep the account, or delete the account itself. We clicked none of these rows.
